    Directing modules with the same dimension vector #

    For representations X, Y of a piece killed by a family F of relations and with the same dimension vector x, the Euler characteristic of the cocycle complex gives dim Hom(X, Y) ≥ q_F(x) - dim H²(X, Y) (one_le_finrank_hom). So if q_F(x) ≥ 1 and H² vanishes in both directions, there are nonzero morphisms both ways; for a directing module and a non-isomorphic indecomposable this is a cycle (not_directing_of_hom_hom; ASS IX.3.1).
